paragraphs.text: Gallia of the Endless Dance is a Satyr from Theros .

Gallia is an infamous female satyr and self-styled Lord of Misrule. She wears bright flowers wound around her horns and carries a mock scepter topped with a goblet. She is fickle and loves novelty, and her main goal is to hold a never-ending party.

In the Echoverse , Gallia died after being poisoned at a feast, but this didn't stop her from continuing to party in the Underworld . As a Returned , she continued to throw banquets without being able to find any attendants. She lost much of her identity, and she progressively forgot why she threw parties at all.
